facts.claim: Spectrum of the Seas (Royal Caribbean): Entered service 2019; 169,000 GT; 4250 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 347 m length; Quantum Ultra class.

Discover a cruise adventure full of new feats and firsts on Spectrum of the Seas, the first of the Quantum Ultra Class cruise ships. Learn more about  Spectrum of the Seas impressive features and amenities.
The award-winning Quantum Class, Spectrum of the Seas® is an adventure full of feats and firsts.

Spectrum of the Seas is a Quantum-Ultra-class cruise ship operated by Royal Caribbean International and the first ship of the Quantum Ultra class, a modification from the company's Quantum class of ships.

catalogSpecs.description: Designed for the Asian market with enhanced suite accommodations and dedicated areas for suite guests.
